name: Eleni and Ayşe

intro.text: We sing in a choir with Greek Cypriots and Turkish Cypriots in it: songs in both languages, and a few that turn out to have the same tune.
We've been friends since the crossings opened in 2003. Two voices, one team. Shall we?

after: There's a love song both sides sing, with words in Greek on one side and Turkish on the other. Each side was sure it was theirs. We sing it in both, one verse each, and nobody argues.
